stable.notes: v0.43.0: the pinout diagram belongs to the housing (Housings tab gets the pinout box, canvas resolves connector -> housing, two connectors on one housing share one pinout); nets in the node dialog - Net band on the wire table, Group by Net / Function / Connector / Remote device / Wire part with collapsible groups, search, Node switch, Matrix tab; blank wire rows are saved and never vanish; Add Device offers every cavity of the new connectors as a wire row. beta.notes:
Splices: a splice is its own part (Parts Database > Splices; Max cross-section and Inner diameter fill each other). In the node editor a splice sits alone on a node or inside a connector's boot: Splice column in the wire table, "+ New splice..." in its dropdown, pigtail rows, a Splices group in the Connectors tab, Place > Splice.
Wire cross-sections are stored in mm2 and shown in the program's unit (Edit > Settings).
Node dialog: Save / Save and close / Close; reopens where it was closed.
Needs the 2026-09-24 database migrations (applied on master).
